glosses: slaglessness, the quality of being free of slag

examples.text: Schon dies erklärt den Unterschied in der Textur der alten Basalte und modernen Laven und der Mangel an flüchtigen Stoffen ist von uns als Grund der Schlackenlosigkeit des Hauynophyrs von Melfi erwähnt worden.
examples.translation: This explains the difference in texture between the old basalts and the modern lavas, and we've mentioned the lack of fluid substances as a reason for the slaglessness of the hauynite from Melfi.
examples.english: This explains the difference in texture between the old basalts and the modern lavas, and we've mentioned the lack of fluid substances as a reason for the slaglessness of the hauynite from Melfi.

examples.text: Die Schlacken können sich aber wieder auflösen und zerschmelzen und dann später an einem andern Orte wieder neu auftauchen, wobei Zeiten gänzlicher Schlackenlosigkeit nicht ausgeschlossen sind.
examples.translation: However, the slag can redissolve and melt away and then later re-emerge at another place, which means that periods of total slaglessness cannot be ruled out.
examples.english: However, the slag can redissolve and melt away and then later re-emerge at another place, which means that periods of total slaglessness cannot be ruled out.

glosses: immaculateness, spotlessness, the quality of being free of any undesired elements or contents

examples.text: Die reale Schöpfung ist zur Basis geworden, und das, was ursprünglich Persönlichkeit dieser Welt war, ist durchwaltet mit einer Weihe und einer Schlackenlosigkeit (inhaltlich und formell) daß wir willig glauben, daß es ist, was es vorgiebt zu sein: das Bild der Göttlichkeit.
examples.translation: The physical creation has become the basis, and that which was originally the personality of the world is pervaded by a holiness and a purity (both in content and form) which we willingly believe is what it pretends to be: the image of godliness.
examples.english: The physical creation has become the basis, and that which was originally the personality of the world is pervaded by a holiness and a purity (both in content and form) which we willingly believe is what it pretends to be: the image of godliness.

examples.text: Nie habe sich je ein Politiker von gleicher Schlackenlosigkeit, Selbstlosigkeit, Wahrhaftigkeit und Gerechtigkeit so lange in führender Stellung behauptet.
examples.translation: Never has a politician of the same purity, selflessness, truthfulness, and justice held their ground for so long.
examples.english: Never has a politician of the same purity, selflessness, truthfulness, and justice held their ground for so long.

examples.text: Diesen Vierzeiler des zweiundzwanzigjährigen Brecht konnten auch die späten Buckower Elegien an Schlackenlosigkeit und verdichtender Kürze nicht übertreffen.
examples.translation: This quatrain of the 22-year-old Brecht's could not even be surpassed by the late Buckow Elegies in terms of polishedness and compact brevity.
examples.english: This quatrain of the 22-year-old Brecht's could not even be surpassed by the late Buckow Elegies in terms of polishedness and compact brevity.
